title: Tool call cards vanish when the turn completes; keep them in the conversation history
description: Live check 2026-10-11 on develop: during a turn the web shows the working indicator (Working, Thinking / Starting your computer) and tool cards (Write file squares.c 126 bytes Done; Terminal gcc ... ./squares Done 383 ms). When the turn completes the committed message replaces the bubble and the cards disappear, and opening an old channel shows no cards. Turn events expire after about 24 h (expires_at), so they cannot be the long-term source. Render the activity from the Pi session transcript (permanent: tool calls and results are in the stored session) by returning tool call and result parts with the committed bot message, with the same sanitising and truncation as the event fields (conversation/src/turn/tool-event-fields.ts), and make the reducer/components render committed activity as well as live events. Scenarios first.
right_now_summary: Tool call cards disappear after a turn ends and are missing from saved conversation history.
